theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_gp_upper_density_le_one
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)) ≤ (unitBallVolume n / 2 ^ n) • (μH[(n : ℝ)] : Measure (Euclid P)) → MeasurableSet M → μHE[n] M < ∞ → ∀ᵐ a ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), limsup (fun r : ℝ => μHE[n] (M ∩ closedBall a r) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ 1
